command:
import json,pathlib
out=pathlib.Path('.skill-runs/write-basic-design-document/out')
doc=json.loads((out/'basic-design-document.json').read_text())
manifest=json.loads((out/'manifest.json').read_text())
text=pathlib.Path('<実行記録の場所>/input.md').read_text()
print('JSON/Markdown/HTML/manifest:',sum((out/name).is_file() for name in ['basic-design-document.json','basic-design-document.md','basic-design-document.html','manifest.json']))
print('Mermaid:',len(list((out/'diagrams').glob('*.mmd'))),'PNG:',len(list((out/'diagrams').glob('*.png'))))
print('資料の引用:',sum(s['quote'] in text for s in doc['sources']),'/',len(doc['sources']))
print('設計:',len(doc['designs']),'要望:',len(doc['requirements']),'未決事項:',len(doc['open_questions']))
for diagram in manifest['diagrams']:
 print(diagram['png'],str(diagram['width'])+'x'+str(diagram['height']))
